name: Dragon Newt
original_name: ドラ ゴ 二ュ一 ト
source: A half-human, half-dragon girl. The dragon newt family far surpasses humanity in physical prowess and fighting skill. In addition, they can use their breath as a weapon. However, this girl is still in training. Nevertheless, her nimble body allows her to unleash quick sword skills that can easily overwhelm the average human warrior.
